text: ENTO 101 Introduction to Academic Success in Entomology Credits: Credit 1. 1 Lecture Hour. Overview: 1 Lecture Hour. text: ENTO 201 General Entomology Credits: 3. 2 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. Overview: 2 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. Survey of the major classes of arthropods with special emphasis on species of economic or biological importance; general insect anatomy, physiology, metamorphosis and classification; survey of the biologies of insect orders and major families using common injurious and beneficial species to relate material to production agriculture and the urban environment.

ENTO 208 Veterinary Entomology Credits: 2. 2 Lecture Hours. Overview: 2 Lecture Hours. Prerequisite: Co-enrollment in ENTO 209 . Prerequisite: Co-enrollment in ENTO 209.
